remarks: Welcome to 101 Parade Hill in New Canaan. This fully renovated, single-level home has been thoughtfully redesigned from top to bottom and offers a rare opportunity for true one-floor living just a short walk from town.  Inside, you'll find a bright, open layout with a modern feel throughout. The kitchen is a standout, featuring striking black and gold appliances and a sleek, contemporary design that flows seamlessly into the main living space, making it great for both everyday life and entertaining. The home offers three generously sized bedrooms and two beautifully updated bathrooms, including a newly reimagined primary suite with its own private en suite.  Major improvements include a brand-new roof, new siding, and central air conditioning, so you can move right in with confidence. Just off the kitchen, a private patio provides a perfect spot for outdoor dining or relaxing.  Set in one of Connecticut's most desirable towns, this home puts you close to downtown New Canaan's shops, restaurants, and amenities, along with access to the area's highly regarded schools. Stylish, low-maintenance, and exceptionally well-located, 101 Parade Hill offers a fantastic opportunity to enjoy modern living in a truly special community.
